facts.text: Al Manara, a Luxury Collection Hotel, sits along the historic shores of Aqaba, Jordan.
facts.excerpt: Welcome to Al Manara, a Luxury Collection Hotel, nestled along the historic shores of Aqaba, Jordan.

facts.text: The hotel has a private beach in Aqaba.
facts.excerpt: Discover our hotel with a private beach in Aqaba and explore Jordan's Golden Triangle

facts.text: Room terraces or balconies look out over the Red Sea and the hotel's private lagoon.
facts.excerpt: From your luxury hotel room's terrace or balcony, marvel at the timeless beauty...See More of the Red Sea and our private hotel lagoon.

facts.text: The accommodations are designed with inspiration from Jordanian heritage and tradition.
facts.excerpt: Step into thoughtfully designed accommodations inspired by Jordanian heritage and tradition at our sea view hotel in Aqaba.

facts.text: Rooms have Luxury Collection signature beds and Frette linens.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy the comfort of Luxury Collection signature beds and Frette luxury linens in your Jordan accommodations.

facts.text: Bathrooms are marble, with bathtubs and Byredo bath amenities.
facts.excerpt: Stay refreshed with marble bathrooms featuring luxurious bathtubs and Byredo bath amenities.

facts.text: Suites, villas and penthouses come with more living space and butler service.
facts.excerpt: Choose from family-friendly suites, villas, or penthouses for more living space and personalized butler service.

facts.text: Each villa has a private pool.
facts.excerpt: Indulge in the luxury of our Villas, each boasting a private pool for your ultimate relaxation.

facts.text: The Prestige Villa has a private pool, a spacious terrace and direct beachfront access.
facts.excerpt: With a private pool, spacious terrace, and direct beachfront access, the Prestige Villa is the perfect escape for those who cherish the outdoors.

facts.text: The Presidential Suite has living and dining areas, a private office, his-and-hers bathrooms and a terrace with a private whirlpool.
facts.excerpt: This exclusive suite features expansive living and dining areas, a private office, his-and-hers bathrooms, and a vast terrace with a private whirlpool.

facts.text: For families, there are interconnecting rooms and villas.
facts.excerpt: For families traveling together, interconnecting rooms and our hotel villas in Aqaba offer added flexibility.

facts.text: The 2 Bedroom Family Suite sleeps up to six.
facts.excerpt: The largest occupancy room at Al Manara, a Luxury Collection Hotel, Saraya Aqaba is the 2 Bedroom Family Suite with a maximum occupancy of 6.

facts.text: Heavenly Spa offers globally inspired treatments, Dead Sea rituals, couples massages and beauty services in a lagoon setting.
facts.excerpt: offering globally inspired treatments, Dead Sea rituals, couples massages, and beauty services in a serene lagoon setting.

facts.text: Heavenly Spa has a couple's room and saunas in both the women's and men's facilities.
facts.excerpt: Heavenly Spa features eight luxurious treatment rooms, an exclusive couple's room, and saunas in both female and male facilities.

facts.text: The outdoor pool area includes a children's pool, with a lifeguard on duty.
facts.excerpt: Children's Pool

facts.text: The concierge can guide guests through Jordan's Golden Triangle, from Petra to Wadi Rum.
facts.excerpt: Let our concierge guide you through the Golden Triangle, from Petra to Wadi Rum

facts.text: Aqaba's seaside has colorful hard and soft coral to explore.
facts.excerpt: Experience a breathtaking variety of colorful hard and soft coral at Aqaba's seaside.

facts.text: Amwaj Art Hub, overlooking the Red Sea, shows paintings by Ghassan Abu Laban and sculptures by Hazem Al-Zubi.
facts.excerpt: Delve into stories told by Ghassan Abu Laban’s brushstrokes, and Hazem Al-Zubi’s sculptures, to discover how each story becomes a timeless masterpiece at Art Hub by Amwaj.

facts.text: Saraya Beach Club, by Eagle Hills in Saraya Aqaba, offers dining and weekly social activities in a family-friendly setting.
facts.excerpt: The Beach Club located in Saraya Aqaba, by Eagle Hills provides one of a kind experience that exceeds expectations with the highest level of service, dining, and weekly social activities in a comfortable family friendly atmosphere

facts.text: Amwaj serves fresh seafood, live grills and cocktails with Red Sea views and live DJ sets.
facts.excerpt: Fresh seafood, live grills, and crafted cocktails are served against Red Sea views, with live DJ sets and a beautifully appointed indoor and outdoor space.

facts.text: Kubba Levantin serves Middle Eastern cuisine and fresh seafood with live entertainment and indoor and outdoor seating.
facts.excerpt: Kubba Levantin is a fine dining restaurant where authentic Middle Eastern cuisine, fresh seafood, and live entertainment come together with craft cocktails and indoor and outdoor seating

facts.text: Taybeh serves Mediterranean cuisine from breakfast through dinner, with Red Sea views from indoor or outdoor seating.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy an international breakfast buffet, live cooking stations, grilled specialties, and indoor or outdoor seating with Red Sea views.

facts.text: Aqaba Airport (AQJ) is about 10 km from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: AQJ is located approximately 10.0 KM from the hotel.

facts.text: Breakfast at Taybeh and Aqwas Lobby Bar is available for a fee.
facts.excerpt: Yes, breakfast is available onsite at Taybeh and Aqwas Lobby Bar for a fee.

facts.text: The hotel calls itself a family hotel celebrated for its service and breakfast.
facts.excerpt: A family hotel in Aqaba celebrated for its outstanding service, exceptional breakfast

facts.text: The hotel holds Green Key certification.
facts.excerpt: The Green Key Certified
